name: Canyon de Chelly & Four Corners
summary: A sacred, still-inhabited Navajo canyon of soaring red walls and ancient cliff dwellings — plus the only spot where four states meet.

lodging.name: A Chinle lodge
lodging.blurb: At the mouth of the canyon on the Navajo Nation.

foodMustTry.name: A Navajo taco
foodMustTry.blurb: On fry bread — a Navajo Nation staple.

days.label: Day 371 — Canyon de Chelly & Four Corners
days.summary: A living canyon and a quadripoint.

item.title: Canyon de Chelly (rim drives & Spider Rock)
item.blurb: The rim overlooks to Spider Rock and the White House Ruins — go down into the canyon only with a Navajo guide.

item.title: Four Corners Monument
item.blurb: Stand in Arizona, New Mexico, Colorado, and Utah at once — the only quadripoint in the country.

commute.scenicNote: North to the most photographed landscape in the West.
